title: Wrong Badge for the Job
description: A dispatcher accidentally tries to assign a customer's account, not a driver's, to drive a shipment. The board should catch that a driverId belongs to the wrong role before creating the assignment.
successCondition: Book a shipment and register a customer account. PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId as a dispatcher with driverId set to the customer's user id, a real vehicleId, and valid scheduledStart/scheduledEnd returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR whose message indicates the id is not a known driver.
hints: The service checks both that the user exists AND that its role is exactly "driver" — a real user id belonging to the wrong role fails the same way as a nonexistent id.
Fetch a real vehicleId from GET /api/fleet/vehicles first so vehicleId isn't itself the reason for the 400.
